# Blind Record System

> Secure record management with blind encryption

## For AI Agents

- Documents Manifest: /docs/_ai/manifest.json
- Tags Index: /docs/_ai/tags.json
- Full Index: /docs/llms-full.txt

## Usage

```bash
# View manifest structure
cat docs/_ai/manifest.json | jq '.knowledgeBase'

# List all documents
cat docs/_ai/manifest.json | jq '.documents[] | {id, name, section}'

# Search by tag
cat docs/_ai/manifest.json | jq '.documents[] | select(.tags[]? | contains("encryption"))'

# Filter by section
cat docs/_ai/manifest.json | jq '.documents[] | select(.section == "WIP")'

# List all tags with counts
cat docs/_ai/tags.json | jq '.tags | to_entries | sort_by(-.value.count) | .[:10]'

# Find documents by tag
cat docs/_ai/tags.json | jq '.tags["encryption"].documents'
```
